card.name: Inside thrombo- and erythropoietin words
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long blood-related words, such as throm, rom or b in thrombocytopenia and thrombotic, and ep or throp in darbepoetin and erythropoietic. It fires in warnings and dosing-table text.

modes.label: Thrombo- words
modes.description: The split piece inside thrombocytopenia, thrombotic or thromboembolism.

modes.label: Erythropoietin-type names
modes.description: The split piece inside darbepoetin or erythropoietic agents.

card.plain: It marks the middle of long blood-clotting and red-cell-stimulating terms, like thrombocytopenia and darbepoetin.
